title: AC1021 colorwh layout and viewport strict output/readback
scope: Bind the exact AC1021 colorwh LAYOUT graph and six paper-space VIEWPORT callback identities through selected ASCII/Binary output, rollback/retry, strict whole-source ASCII conversion, and fresh same-version DXF readback.

authority.dwgSpecification: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1, §§20.4.38 VIEWPORT ENTITY and 20.4.84 LAYOUT
rulesApplied: VIEWPORT common entity fields include the optional 340 clip-boundary soft pointer; version-specific common handle roles are decoded separately.
LAYOUT has an ordered viewport count/list, paper-space BLOCK_RECORD association, and last-active viewport reference.
Nonrectangular-clip flag and the presence of a 340 boundary handle must agree; the local adapter gate also requires the target entity role and bounded reference closure.
authority.authorityLimit: The specification supports byte/reference roles, not native display or clipping semantics.

source.provenanceLimit: Existing local drawing. Its AutoCAD/Autodesk metadata and LibreDWG peer output do not independently authenticate the source author or producer. No drawing fixture or derivative is committed.

independentPeerObservation.observation: Reports the same Model, AutoCAD Color Index and True Color LAYOUT identities and six listed type-34 VIEWPORT handles. Its null owner values for 0x1D7E and 0x1D81 were not treated as proof of source owner role; local layout membership, container and reciprocal BLOCK_RECORD checks govern that role.
independentPeerObservation.limit: Peer parsing corroborates identities only; it is not an independent encoder or native semantic test.

sourceProfile.group68And69: Status and ID are DXF output projections derived from ordered LAYOUT membership; ODA §20.4.38 does not store DXF groups 68/69 in the DWG VIEWPORT body.
sourceProfile.optionalReferences: All six selected VIEWPORTs have no extension dictionary or reactors. The two nonrectangular-clip flags correspond exactly to their 340 CIRCLE targets; each circle is unique, paper-space, and co-owned in the source entity container.
sourceProfile.opaqueCallbackCensus: 52 total; the exact six VIEWPORT identities were the remaining unqualified callbacks after the LAYOUT slice.

implementation.summary: Adds an exact AC1021 colorwh LAYOUT graph profile and exact six-VIEWPORT source/output profile. Adds output/readback checks for source LAYOUT membership, reciprocal paper-space BLOCK_RECORDs, layer and visual-style targets, viewport status/ID derivation, clip-flag/handle agreement, remapped CIRCLE targets and geometry, plus atomic refusal and same-adapter retry. The layer-reference preflight now permits the source-bound planned LAYER remap while BLOCKS are emitted; finalizeDwgLineTypeControlOutput still verifies the actual staged LAYER record and mapped handle after the table output is available.
implementation.scope: Exact source profile only. Type 34, other layouts, other clip-boundary graphs, producer-wide support and native clipping semantics remain unqualified.
